generator_metadata.summary: A zero-background grid has a selector in the top-left corner and at least two coloured seeds elsewhere. Selector 1 chooses the five-cell plus stencil; selectors 2..7 choose the five-cell diagonal X. The output is a fresh zero grid containing the in-bounds union of those stencils in cyan (8); the selector itself is not copied to the output.

review_brief:
# Review: 84730935f58f · generator 2.1.0

Defect → repair: the old first four demonstrations could all select PLUS; the generator now alternates PLUS/X by sample index and every four-example schedule teaches both branches.
Canonical preservation: `render_mode=union` is byte-for-byte the canonical Racket program (`cb0eb8d9e46e…`); no canonical authority or approval flag changed.
Built: native `overlap_highlight` family with a coverage-multiplicity intermediate, thin adapter, promotion declaration, tests, inventory, protected preflight, causal witness, and sequential public projection.
Focused tests: 31/31 passed on final task source.
Bounded audit: 768 base draws; 144 episodes / 1,104 pairs; 144 minimum lessons refuted declared fixed-stencil/wrong-render rivals; 24 crossed controls changed the intended intermediate.
Protected execution: authoring preflight passed 32 Racket evaluations; one causal counterfactual changed the selected qualified output under protected Racket.
Public boundary: 16 single-query views verified; 24 first-turn invariance checks passed; five malformed/private/duplicate negative controls were rejected.
Remaining limit: finite checks do not prove universal identifiability or causal depth. Owner source review, native acceptance, and training admission were not performed.
Status: reviewer-ready source delta; owner attention required for acceptance.

Evidence: `checks/84730935f58f/qualification/`, `checks/84730935f58f/causal-witness/`, `checks/84730935f58f/adversarial/report.json`, and `checks/84730935f58f/first-turn-report.json`.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h, w~6-10) with: (a) CELL (0, 0) is the STENCIL SELECTOR — value 1 encodes PLUS growth, any other non-0 value (from {2..7}) encodes X (diagonal) growth; (b) 2-4 SEED CELLS at scattered positions (not at (0, 0)) in random colors from {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9}. Seeds placed away from (0, 0) to avoid growth overlap with the legend. Rule (STENCIL GROWTH PER SELECTOR, PAINT 8): READ SELECTOR = g[0][0]. If selector == 1 → PLUS pattern (4 cardinal neighbors); else → X pattern (4 diagonal neighbors). For EACH non-(0, 0) SEED at (r, c): PAINT the seed cell AND its 4-stencil neighbors (plus or X) with COLOR-8 (cyan). The selector cell stays. Background stays 0. Net: legend at (0, 0) picks plus-vs-X growth; each seed expands into that stencil shape in cyan.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent per-cell coverage multiplicity map produced by the selector-chosen stencil.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read the selector, choose the plus or diagonal-X stencil, and expand every seed while retaining one hit for each seed-stencil cell.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint cells covered once cyan (8), cells covered at least twice red (2), and all other cells zero.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B cannot choose output colours until A computes multiplicities; using plus footprints for this X-selected input changes both the covered set and which cells are overlaps.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical union default plus an overlap-highlighting setting whose output depends on selector-derived coverage multiplicity; source-bound authoring preflight and protected causal replay passed, with owner acceptance and training admission still pending.

target_report.summary: Repaired the base lesson schedule and dead controls, preserved the canonical rule exactly, and built a source-bound two-setting native family with bounded adversarial, protected-Racket, causal-witness, and public-export evidence.
